title: 数量代词辨析

examples.en: Both of my parents are teachers.
examples.zh: 我父母两个人都是老师。

examples.en: Neither of the two boys is right.
None of the students was late.

guess.question: Neither of the boys ____ right. 这里谓语用 is 还是 are？

options.text: 用 is——neither 表示“两个都不”，按单数处理
options.feedback: 对！neither、either、each、none 都按单数处理，考试以单数为标准答案。

options.text: 用 are——因为 boys 是复数
options.feedback: 不对——neither 才是主语，后面的 of 短语只是补充说明范围。
不对——考试统一按单数算，写 are 会被扣分。

rule.rule: both（两者都，复数）／either（两者中任一，单数）／neither（两者都不，单数且表否定）／all（三者及以上都）／none（三者及以上都不）／each（每一个，单数）
rule.formula: ① 两者：both A and B（复数）　② either A or B / neither A nor B（谓语就近）　③ 三者及以上：all / none　④ each / every + 单数谓语　⑤ both + 复数名词；either + 单数名词

anchors.en: There are trees on both sides of the street.
You can sit on either side of the table.
anchors.zh: 桌子两边你坐哪边都行。

trap.wrong: Neither of the answers are correct.
trap.right: Neither of the answers is correct.
trap.why: neither 作主语按单数处理，谓语用 is。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——both 跟复数，either / neither / each / none 跟单数；说到“两个”用 both/neither，说到“三个以上”用 all/none。

check.stem: — Which do you like, tea or coffee? — ____. I'd like some water.

options.distractor: 两个都喜欢的话就不会要水了
任一都行的话就不会要水了

check.stem: There are many tall trees on ____ side of the street.

options.distractor: both 后面要接复数 sides

check.explanation: 空后 side 是单数，用 either（两边中任一边）。

options.text: Neither of the boys is from Beijing.
Neither of the boys are from Beijing.
options.distractor: neither 作主语按单数处理

options.text: Neither of the boys be from Beijing.
Neither of the boys were from Beijing.
options.distractor: 这里用一般现在时，且要用单数

check.explanation: neither 作主语，谓语用 is。
